title: NYT Connections Game Answers and Hints Provided
summary: Multiple outlets provided answers, hints, and explanations for the New York Times' 'Connections' game for August 18 and 19, 2026. The coverage focused on offering solutions and clues for the popular word puzzle.
summary_points: Answers and hints for the NYT Connections game were published.
The coverage pertains to the August 18 and 19, 2026 editions of the game.
Specific game titles mentioned include 'Connections', 'Strands', and 'Pips'.
The content offered solutions and explanations for the word puzzle.
